resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and Nynorsk source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review, queue validation, typecheck, 79 test files with 462 tests, complete build, route checks, and generated-link checks passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded Nynorsk pass identified 25 remaining mixed-language and terminology issues across trigonometry, heat capacity, heat flux, SI conversions, and wire gauges; all 25 were corrected.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Nynorsk human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted.

findings.summary: The right-triangle explanation needed a more consistent Nynorsk rendering of the trigonometric relationships.
evidence: The previous paragraph mixed otherwise correct Nynorsk with a less consistent explanatory phrasing.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the paragraph with consistent terms for the opposite side, adjacent side, hypotenuse, and SOH-CAH-TOA.

findings.summary: The example title used the less precise generic noun side.
evidence: The previous title was ‘Finn ei side’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the clearer Nynorsk title ‘Finn ei sidelengd’.

findings.summary: The waveform notation bullet used uninflected or mixed forms for the named quantities.
evidence: The previous bullet said ‘A er amplitude, f er frekvens ... t er tid ... φ er fasevinkel’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘A er amplituden, f er frekvensen i hertz, t er tida i sekund, og φ er fasevinkelen’.

findings.summary: The direction-and-phase instruction retained Bokmål forms.
evidence: The previous bullet used ‘Behold fortegn’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the Nynorsk wording ‘Behald forteikn’.

findings.summary: The heat-capacity definition omitted the natural Nynorsk definite form.
evidence: The previous bullet said ‘C er varmekapasitet’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘C er varmekapasiteten’.

findings.summary: The heat-energy definition was underspecified.
evidence: The previous bullet only said ‘Q er overført varmeenergi’.
findings.resolution: Clarified it as ‘Q er tilført eller overført varmeenergi i joule (J)’.

findings.summary: The mass and specific-heat definition mixed indefinite and definite forms.
evidence: The previous bullet said ‘m er masse ... c er spesifikk varmekapasitet’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to consistent Nynorsk: ‘m er massen ... c er den spesifikke varmekapasiteten’.

findings.summary: The worked example used Bokmål forms for water, temperature change, and the imperative.
evidence: The previous setup said ‘Varm opp ... vann fra ...’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Varm opp 0,20 kg vatn frå 20 °C til 70 °C ...’.

findings.summary: The section title was unnecessarily long and less direct.
evidence: The previous title was ‘Oppvarming med elektrisk effekt’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the concise title ‘Elektrisk oppvarming’.

findings.summary: The object/material contrast used the less natural Bokmål-style connector kontra.
evidence: The previous title was ‘Objekt kontra materiale’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the clearer Nynorsk title ‘Objekt og materiale’.

findings.summary: The heat-flux density term used the Bokmål form tetthet.
evidence: The previous bullet said ‘varmestrømstetthet’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the Nynorsk technical term ‘varmestrømtettleik’.

findings.summary: The heat-transfer-rate definition used an inconsistent adjective form.
evidence: The previous bullet said ‘samlet varmeoverføringsrate’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘samla varmeoverføringsrate’.

findings.summary: The area definition used an incomplete passive construction.
evidence: The previous bullet said ‘arealet som varmen overføres gjennom’.
findings.resolution: Clarified it as ‘arealet som varmen blir overført gjennom’.

findings.summary: The definition paragraph used the less natural distinction between stored energy and heat flow.
evidence: The previous paragraph used ‘lagret energi’ and mixed ‘beskriver’ with the surrounding Nynorsk.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with ‘lagra energi’ and consistent Nynorsk technical wording.

findings.summary: The example conclusion used the Bokmål form gjennomsnittlige and tetthet.
evidence: The previous conclusion said ‘Den gjennomsnittlige varmestrømstettheten’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Den gjennomsnittlege varmestrømtettleiken’.

findings.summary: The conductivity definition used the Bokmål compound varmeledningsevne.
evidence: The previous bullet said ‘k er varmeledningsevne’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘k er varmeleiingsevna’.

findings.summary: The temperature-difference definition used the Bokmål form temperaturforskjellen.
evidence: The previous bullet said ‘ΔT er temperaturforskjellen over laget’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘ΔT er temperaturskilnaden over laget’.

findings.summary: The area-conversion instruction retained the Bokmål imperative and verb.
evidence: The previous bullet said ‘Konverter arealet ... før du bruker W/m²’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Gjer om arealet ... før du brukar W/m²’.

findings.summary: The localized conversion formula used a decimal point instead of the locale's decimal comma.
evidence: The previous formula was ‘1 in² = 645.16 mm²’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘1 in² = 645,16 mm²’.

findings.summary: The length-conversion setup used Bokmål imperative and plural forms.
evidence: The previous setup began ‘Konverter ...’ and ended ‘5 mm til tommer’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Gjer om ... og 5 mm til tommar’.

findings.summary: The length-conversion title used the Bokmål plural tommer.
evidence: The previous title was ‘Tommer og metrisk lengd’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Tommar og metrisk lengd’.

findings.summary: The AWG history bullet used the Bokmål adverb også.
evidence: The previous bullet said ‘også historisk kjent’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘òg historisk kjent’.

findings.summary: The SWG description used the Bokmål compound platetykkelse.
evidence: The previous bullet ended ‘for tråd- og platetykkelse’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘for tråd- og platetjukkleik’.

findings.summary: The system-comparison title used the Bokmål form Hvorfor.
evidence: The previous title was ‘Hvorfor systemnavnet er viktig’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Kvifor systemnamnet er viktig’.

findings.summary: The nominal-dimensions note retained multiple Bokmål forms.
evidence: The previous paragraph used ‘Disse’, ‘verdiene’, ‘flertrådet’, and ‘oppbygning’.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with consistent Nynorsk: ‘Desse verdiane’, ‘fleirtråda’, and ‘oppbygging’.
